joker_substrate_compost.name: Montón de Compost

joker_poison_bloom.name: Floración Venenosa

joker_crystal_lens.name: Lente de Cristal

joker_mycelial_network.name: Red Micelial

joker_symbiotic_pact.name: Pacto Simbiótico

joker_parasitic_drive.name: Impulso Parásito

mutation_extra_hand.name: Mano Extra

mutation_hand_size.name: Mano Más Grande

mutation_joker_slot.name: Ranura de Joker
